description: Source code for a SHA1 encryption driver for the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) module on the Danube platform, including hardware interaction and cryptographic function registration.

classes.name: sha1_ctx
classes.description: Private context structure for SHA1 hashing, maintaining state, count, and buffer.

methods.name: sha1_transform1
methods.description: Main interface to SHA1 hardware, processes a 64-byte input block and updates the hash state.

methods.name: sha1_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly, updating the SHA1 context.

methods.name: sha1_final
methods.description: Computes the final SHA1 hash value and cleans up the context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1
methods.description: Registers the SHA1 driver with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_sha1
methods.description: Unregisters the SHA1 driver from the Linux crypto API.
